name: B10-0277/2025 – § 8 – Am 30
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 8.Calls on the Commission to take into account, in safeguarding both security of supply and affordability, all available technologies that contribute to achieving a cost-effective, cleaner, stable, secure and more independent energy mix; recognises, in fact, that clean and low-carbon energy, especially nuclear for those Member States that decide to use it, is essential for a clean and secure energy mix; urges the Commission to propose a long-term nuclear energy strategy that also includes, among other things, support for the deployment of large reactors, as well as the development of fourth-generation reactors; calls on the Commission to strengthen cooperation on the safe development and production of small modular reactors in Europe and to advance research in nuclear fusion as a future energy technology; welcomes the announced assessment of the possibility of streamlining licensing practices for new nuclear energy technologies;
